laat_vaar.voor: Op hul sweeftuie het hulle geleer
laat_vaar.na: Met hul sweeftuie het hulle geleer
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Met' reads more naturally than 'op' for learning a skill by means of the gliders.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The preposition swap moves the meaning: 'op' says they learned while flying aboard the gliders, which is natural Afrikaans ('op 'n fiets leer ry'), while 'met' says they learned by means of them, so the change is at best lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: Met die enjin en sterk wind kon
laat_vaar.na: Met die enjin en 'n sterk wind kon
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A single countable wind needs the article here; 'en sterk wind' sounds clipped.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Sterk wind' as an uncountable noun is idiomatic Afrikaans ('daar was sterk wind'), so adding the article is a lateral move that only adds a word.

vlae.teks: 'n Sweeftuig sak deur die lug om hom. Hy moet dus eers hoogte kry voordat hy kan gly.
vlae.rede: The glider is 'dit' in the block 'Hul eerste vliegtuig was 'n sweeftuig' but 'hy' here; both are acceptable Afrikaans and the protected 'deur die lug om hom' sits beside both, so I did not change it, but a person may want one pronoun throughout.
